name: Fun Monke Horror 3
summary:
This is Fun Monke Horror 3.. This is based off of OG FMH, and I thank the developers for the ideas and some maps.

Run from the monsters, play with friends, wear some cool cosmetics, and have fun!

There are lots of popular maps in the game, such as, Dev Town, Crawlspace, Run, Meetup, and much more! We have working servers, color changing, name changing, lobby music, and lots more!
